prompt: a red fox sitting in deep snow, golden hour light
transport: SSH PTY; actual zdraw iTerm image output displayed with xterm.js

host.thermal_before: pmset reports no thermal or performance warning
host.thermal_after: pmset reports no thermal or performance warning
host.note: These reports are not temperature measurements.

scope: First render in a new session with cached weight pages, then a resident reroll with cached conditioning and an explicit save. Complete inference intervals; no cuts or acceleration.
cli_memory_label_note: The CLI currently labels this GB, but calculates GiB. It is completion physical footprint, not peak RSS or total RAM.
preview_method: Approximate linear latent projection after each denoising step; final image uses the full VAE decode.
final_visible_label_check: pass; no approximate-preview label remains above either final image

capture_tools.method: Headless Chromium CDP screencast of a real SSH PTY terminal; original frame timestamps retained in ffconcat; ffmpeg resampled to 30 fps MP4 and 10 fps GIF.

capture_selection: The first progressive take was rejected because compact progress output left an approximate label above the final image. After fixing and retesting that bug, this complete take passed the visible-text assertion and visual review. No take was selected for fastest timing.
